description: Covenant Bible note schema for scripture overlay reading

fields.covenant: Covenant in view: Adamic | Noahic | Abrahamic | Mosaic | Davidic | New | LDS-extension
fields.phase: formation | ratification | breach | judgment | intercession | renewal | fulfillment | echo
fields.god_obligation: What God committed to in this covenant's terms
fields.event: What actually happens in the passage
fields.broken: Array of specific verse references for commandments/terms breached (enables cross-canon queries)
fields.divine_action: Controlled verb: sustains | judges | withholds | restores | remembers | confronts | proposes | relents | refuses | observes | guides | provides
fields.divine_character: Attribute on display: mercy | justice | patience | jealousy | covenant-keeping | holiness | sovereignty
fields.divine_motive: Why, as far as the text states: for His name's sake | for the patriarchs' sake | to keep His word | covenant enforcement
fields.delivered: Covenant-scoped instance of divine action — the specific promise kept inside that covenant's terms
fields.consequence: Immediate result: blessing, warning, curse, restoration, delay
fields.principle: One-sentence distilled takeaway naming the recurring rule
fields.pattern: Human-readable name of the registry pattern referenced by pattern_id (kept in sync with pattern_registry)
fields.pattern_id: Pointer to master pattern registry (e.g. P001). Notes whose pattern is flagged in restoration_patterns appear in Restoration (gospel) mode
fields.context: Ancient Near East background — the 'world of the Bible' material that makes the principle land
fields.echoes: Cross-references where this event or principle recurs (Bible, Book of Mormon, D&C, NT)
fields.confidence: high | medium | low — distinguishes explicit textual claims from interpretive inference

pattern_registry.P005: New Covenant Written on the Heart
